name: oct

scripts.build: bun run typecheck && vite build --config web/vite.config.ts

//: `svelte-check` is the interface's Svelte-aware type checker: `tsc --noEmit` runs over the logic files only and sees a `.svelte` import as an opaque value (`web/src/ambient.d.ts`), so component wiring — a missing required prop, a prop passed after removal, a forward to something gone — was never checked. It is now part of `typecheck` (and `build`, which reuses it) instead of a command someone has to remember. `typescript` is pinned to 6.x because svelte-check's language server supports TypeScript <= 6; TypeScript 7 is the native reimplementation of 6, and svelte-check cannot consume it as its compiler API, so this is the version whose semantics both passes share, not a weakened `tsc`.
